message.content: Confirmed the three existing AND cases fail. I’m adding `__and__` alongside `__or__`, preserving commutative cache hashes and non-cacheable behavior.

function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /testbed && apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tinydb/queries.py
@@
     def __or__(self, other: 'QueryInstance') -> 'QueryInstance':
@@
         else:
             hashval = None
         return QueryInstance(lambda value: self(value) or other(value), hashval)
+
+    def __and__(self, other: 'QueryInstance') -> 'QueryInstance':
+        # AND is commutative, so use an unordered hash representation.
+        if self.is_cacheable() and other.is_cacheable():
+            hashval = ('and', frozenset([self._hash, other._hash]))
+        else:
+            hashval = None
+        return QueryInstance(lambda value: self(value) and other(value), hashval)
 
     def __invert__(self) -> 'QueryInstance':
*** End Patch
PATCH
python - <<'PY'
from tinydb import TinyDB, Query
from tinydb.queries import QueryInstance
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage

db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
User = Query()
db.insert_multiple([{'age': 20, 'name': 'John'}, {'age': 17, 'name': 'John'}, {'age': 21, 'name': 'Jane'}])
assert len(db.search((User.age > 18) & (User.name == 'John'))) == 1
q = Query()
assert (q.value.exists() & (q.value == 5))({'value': 5})
assert not (q.value.exists() & (q.value == 5))({})
assert ((~(q.value == 1)) & (q.value == 5))({'value': 5})
assert not ((~(q.value == 1)) & (q.value == 5))({'value': 1})
# Uncacheable instances remain uncacheable and retain short-circuit evaluation.
a = QueryInstance(lambda value: False, None)
b = QueryInstance(lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError()), None)
combined = a & b
assert not combined({}) and not combined.is_cacheable()
print('reproduction and edge checks passed')
PY
pytest -q tests/test_queries.py"}
